gameAccounts.help: So others can find you on Steam, EA and co. The “Playing now” agent fills in Steam automatically; maintain the rest here. Visible to all signed-in participants.

presence.setup.privacy: Voluntary: only the detected game is reported, never the list of your programs. Who plays what is kept in memory only; two minutes after the agent stops, your entry is gone. The agent also adds your Steam account (ID and display name, never the login name) to your game accounts.
presence.setup.noAgent: This installation has no bundled agent. It ships with the “Now playing” module from matchdesk-modules.
presence.setup.createError: That did not work, please try again.
presence.setup.steps: 1. Download and install the agent (no admin rights needed). It then runs quietly in the notification area next to the clock and starts with Windows. 2. Click “Connect agent” and confirm “Open” in the browser.
presence.setup.smartscreen: Until the agent is signed, Windows warns during installation (“Windows protected your PC”). Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
presence.setup.keyStatus: Agent connected since {created}, last report: {used}. Connecting again disconnects the previous agent.
presence.setup.pairNote: The agent asks whether it should connect to this server and shows the code {code}. If nothing happens, the agent is not installed yet. The code is valid for five minutes.
